scope: Read-only diagnosis and experiment design from verified formal G/F archives. Future trajectories are not available to online controllers. No H4 or new arm action is executed; H1 gate and root determine any later H4 experiment.

method.crossing: First forward sign change of ball_x minus moving reference plane after launch; linear interpolation between adjacent original 1 ms samples. Robot native projection uses mj_kinematics on unchanged archived qpos only; no mj_step.

reference_planes.g_deadline: base_x - 0.81 m; G conservative earliest collision deadline, not an actual surface
reference_planes.native_front_projection: min original robot native collider world x minus ball radius; an infinite projected supporting plane, not a y/z collision certificate

method.time_budget: Hypothetical launch-responsive timing: recorded first postlaunch G refresh delay + H0 airborne wall-clock proxy + frozen 2 s quintic rise. Offline sim time does not absorb wall runtime automatically. Partial-ramp contact is not ruled out by incomplete full pose.

geometry_reference.small_candidate_scope: 13 static poses at fixed reference root; these heights are not dynamic reachability upper bounds for arbitrary poses/root motion

frozen_action.response_window: final one second of hold vs same-time original baseline

runtime_proxy.scope: Reference latency only; not separately measured latency for each audited shot or certified upper bound

shots.name: air_wide

first_refresh_current_body_coverage.assumption: frozen current pose; false can also mean sparse trajectory sampling

first_refresh_target_body_coverage.assumption: frozen current pose and candidate lateral translation

conclusion_limits: Full 2 s rise cannot finish before these crossings even with zero waiting/runtime; incomplete rise may still make contact.
Pointwise geometric exclusions apply only at their stated instant and original measured base height; later descending flight/changed root height can alter them.
Small static candidate maximum height is not an arbitrary dynamic pose bound.
G used existing native pose/lateral gait; no new arm action was implemented. No action-failure attribution or H4 outcome is inferred.

first_refresh_reachability.reason: insufficient time, braking time or post clearance
